newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares up slightly as buyers return.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares up slightly as buyers return.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index closed slightly higher on Wednesday as investors began to return to the market to buy towards the end of the reporting season for 1996 corporate results, brokers said.
The index rose 1.26 points or 0.79 percent to 160.78 on turnover of HK$89.4 million, compared with Tuesday's HK$90.4 million.
Analysts said buying interest is returning to the sluggish market as investors overcome concerns about 1996 results.
"Quite a few blue chip firms have reported decent 1996 results, and investors have a good idea of what the rest will look like," said an analyst at J&A Securities.
Buyers are focussing on large companies that have or are expected to post strong profits, analysts said.

"High-performing firms like Fangda are definately the hot stocks at the moment," said a trader at China Guotai Securities. Shenzhen Fangda Industrial Co Ltd was the best performer today, gaining HK$0.73 or 7.05 percent to HK$11.09 on volume of 507,100 shares.
Investors are now turning their eyes to buying opportunities ahead of the Hong Kong handover on July 1, analysts said,
Analysts said they expect to see steady rises on both the Hong Kong and Shenzhen stock exchanges around the time of the handover.
The A share index added 1.45 points or 0.31 percent to 461.27 on turnover of 9.02 billion yuan, compared with Tuesday's 7.74 billion.
